svg.text: Section through the right seam at x = 73
Inside the cradle's right side wall (x 65.5..74.5), 1.5 mm from the seam face, so the spline seat at the bottom and the top-key seat in the rim both cut through.
Traced from the solids: every 0.5 mm of y, every z span of material becomes one column. The staircase on the slopes is the trace, not the part.
